signmirrors.config.title: Sign Mirrors
signmirrors.config.enabled.tooltip: Turn every [Mirror] sign back into a plain sign.
signmirrors.config.technique.tooltip: Planar: exact reflections, re-rendered from your reflected eye as you move (one render per mirror). Cube map: parallax-corrected cube map from a fixed point; cheaper while you move, but things that aren't on the room's walls (floor near the mirror, furniture, you) look distorted, especially toward the edges.
signmirrors.config.preset.tooltip: Sets the Quality and Performance options together.
signmirrors.config.preset.note: Choosing a preset sets the Quality and Performance pages. Changing any of those settings yourself switches the preset to Custom.
signmirrors.config.minResolution.tooltip: Cube-face size used for small or distant mirrors.
signmirrors.config.maxResolution.tooltip: Cube-face size used when a mirror fills the view. The single biggest quality setting.
signmirrors.config.resolutionScale.toolt: How sharp reflections are relative to the screen. 100% gives roughly one reflection texel per screen pixel of mirror height; mirrors you look at closely get more detail.
signmirrors.config.refreshHiddenFaces.to: Occasionally re-render parts of the reflection you can't currently see, so they're up to date when you move.
signmirrors.config.recursiveMirrors.tool: Show other mirrors inside reflections (one frame behind).
signmirrors.config.reflectivity.tooltip: Brightness of the reflection. Real mirrors reflect a little under 100%.
signmirrors.config.facesPerFrame.tooltip: World renders spent on reflections each frame (one per planar mirror, or one per cube face), shared out by priority: bigger, closer, more central mirrors first. The main performance cost.
signmirrors.config.maxActiveMirrors.tool: Only this many of the most important visible mirrors are kept up to date.
signmirrors.config.maxMirrorDistance.too: Beyond this, mirrors show as plain signs.
signmirrors.config.frustumCulling.toolti: Don't update or draw mirrors that are off-screen.
signmirrors.config.occlusionCulling.tool: Don't update or draw mirrors that are completely behind blocks or other mirrors.
signmirrors.config.occlusionCheckInterva: Frames between visibility raycasts for each mirror. Lower reacts faster; higher is cheaper.
signmirrors.config.visibilityGraceFrames: Frames a mirror keeps being drawn after it was last seen, to avoid popping.
signmirrors.config.disableOcclusionCulli: Turn off chunk occlusion culling while rendering reflections, so areas hidden from you but visible in a mirror aren't missing. Costs some CPU.
signmirrors.config.proxyMaxDistance.tool: How far the parallax correction looks for walls. Larger suits mirrors outdoors.
signmirrors.config.probeOffset.tooltip: How far in front of the mirror the reflection camera sits.
signmirrors.config.flipFaceV.tooltip: Only needed if reflections appear upside down on your graphics backend.
